definition: the one state where the whole machine runs, senses and feelings and all

settled:
Asleep I get novel-length stories, half a dozen characters, full settings, and an emotional score under them.

That is the proof the break is at recall and nowhere earlier. The parts that build it are all there.

The same brain that cannot pre-play anything awake builds whole worlds all night.

More of my cortisol at bedtime means more nightmares. That is the whole of what I claim. I have nothing beyond stress on what any of them mean.

Lately most of them have been nightmares, and I put that down to being in a turbulent stretch.

I have gone through phases of writing them down on waking, as story ideas, before they go back behind the break.
